mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle, which raises discount rates for equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS change (positive) and 5d SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or negative 5d returns occur in <40% of instances with rising FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 5.0%, the Rank IC for UNRATE level and 20d SPX returns is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is low (UNRATE < 5.0%) and the federal funds rate is elevated (FEDFUNDS > 0.3%), the market interprets this as aggressive monetary tightening in a strong economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with high rates
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE < 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 0.3%, the Rank IC for the joint signal and 20d SPX returns is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS change (positive) and 20d SPX returns is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST change (positive) and 60d SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or positive 60d returns occur in <40% of instances with rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO YoY growth < 0.5%) signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic deceleration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO YoY growth < 0.5%, the Rank IC for INDPRO growth and 5d SPX returns is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) both rise month-over-month, it indicates broad-based economic strength across the housing and manufacturing sectors, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both increasing month-over-month
failure_condition: In instances where HOUST and INDPRO both increase, the Rank IC for the joint signal and 20d SPX returns is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a very tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%), a strong payroll gain (PAYEMS growth > 100k) signals overheating that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.5%, the Rank IC for PAYEMS growth (positive) and 20d SPX returns is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
